Card Q&A.q: If I have exactly 3 cards in my security stack, do I activate both the "trash the top card of your opponent's security stack" effect and the "gain 2 memory" effect when activating this card's [All Turns] effect?

Effect: [When Digivolving] Suspend 1 of your opponent’s Digimon. Then, 1 of their Digimon can't unsuspend until the end of their turn.

[All Turns] When this Digimon deletes an opponent's Digimon in battle, if you have 3 or more security cards, trash the top card of your opponent's security stack. If you have 3 or fewer, gain 2 memory.
